title: 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Premium Stock - #239 Matisse Thybulle (RC) 76ers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019-20 Panini NBA Hoops Premium Stock trading card features Philadelphia 76ers rookie Matisse Thybulle in a Silver Prizm parallel variety. The card is a part of the base set and has the card number 239. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini for the National Basketball Association (NBA) league. 

The card is not autographed and is a great addition to any basketball fan's collection. It is a part of the 2019-20 season and is perfect for any collector looking to add a rookie card to their collection.
